import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int w = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();
        boolean ans = check(w, m) || check(w, m - 1) || check(w, m + 1);
        if (ans)
            System.out.println("YES");
        else
            System.out.println("NO");
        scanner.close();
    }

    static boolean check(int w, int m) {
        if (m == 0)
            return true;
        if (m % w != 0)
            return false;
        m = m / w;
        if (m == 1)
            return true;
        return check(w, m) || check(w, m - 1) || check(w, m + 1);
    }
}
